cases.reply:
Fixed the data race in `internal/sim/match.go`.

`Join` wrote to `m.players` from the connection goroutine while `Step` ranged over the same map on the tick goroutine. `Match` now carries a `sync.RWMutex`:

- `Join` takes the write lock around the insert
- `Step` holds the read lock for the whole iteration

`go test -race ./internal/sim/...` passes now, no more `WARNING: DATA RACE`. One caveat: `Step` holds the read lock while calling `Advance`, so `Advance` must never call back into `Join`.

Changes in `app/text.py`:
